# Source: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max: # Adapted for wisp-design: schema condensed to 6 columns; web stacks only.

column3: weight and size carry hierarchy (not colour).
prompt
column4: css_template

column3: Primary action — solid ink on ground, no colour accent
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--mn-fg); color: var(--mn-ground); border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--mn-sans); font-weight: 500; transition: opacity 200ms;
column5: ☐ AA contrast fg/ground ☐ no chromatic accent ☐ hover shifts opacity to 0.85 ☐ visible focus ring

column3: Secondary — outlined, monotone
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--mn-fg); border: 1px solid var(--mn-fg); border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on border + text ☐ hover inverts fg/ground ☐ no chromatic shift

column3: Ghost button — no chrome, hover-shifts-opacity
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--mn-fg-muted); border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500; transition: color 150ms;
column5: ☐ hover shifts color to fg ☐ visible focus ring ☐ adequate touch target

column3: Display headline — large size carries hierarchy, single hue
column4: font-family: var(--mn-sans); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--mn-fg);
column5: ☐ size + weight carry hierarchy (no colour) ☐ line-height tight ☐ AA contrast

column3: Body — single hue, generous line-height
column4: font-family: var(--mn-sans); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 65ch; color: var(--mn-fg);
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ max 65ch ☐ line-height 1.55-1.65

column3: Feature card — soft tint of single hue, subtle border
column4: padding: 24px; background: var(--mn-bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--mn-border); border-radius: 8px;
column5: ☐ no chromatic accent ☐ border passes AA visibility ☐ no soft chromatic shadow

column3: Hero — single hue, weight + size carry, generous space
column4: max-width: 72ch; margin-inline: auto; padding-block: 96px; text-align: center;
column5: ☐ no decorative chromatic graphic ☐ no hero-metric template ☐ single CTA

column3: Top nav — monotone, hairline divider
column4: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 32px; background: var(--mn-ground); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mn-border);
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ skip-link ☐ aria-current ☐ no chromatic accent

column3: Text input — neutral border, focus deepens border
column4: padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--mn-ground); color: var(--mn-fg); border: 1px solid var(--mn-border); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 16px;
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px iOS ☐ focus shifts border to fg ☐ AA contrast

column3: Data table — single hue, tabular-nums, hairline rules
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--mn-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px;
column5: ☐ tabular-nums ☐ hairline rules ☐ no chromatic zebra ☐ AA contrast

column3: Status badge — monotone, weight carries meaning
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--mn-bg-elev); color: var(--mn-fg); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
column5: ☐ semantic colour + icon + text (not colour alone — here meaning via weight) ☐ AA contrast

column3: Filter tag — monotone pill, removable
column4: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--mn-bg-elev); color: var(--mn-fg-muted); font-size: 13px;
column5: ☐ remove button keyboard-reachable ☐ AA contrast ☐ aria-label includes action

column3: Section divider — hairline, single hue
column4: height: 1px; background: var(--mn-border); margin-block: 48px;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ no gradient ☐ aria-hidden if decorative

column3: Modal — monotone card, overlay
column4: position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; background: oklch(15% 0 0 / 0.5);
column5: ☐ focus-trap ☐ ESC closes ☐ ARIA dialog role ☐ inert background

column3: Empty state — monotone, specific microcopy, single CTA
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 64px 24px; text-align: center; color: var(--mn-fg-muted);
column5: ☐ specific copy (no 'Welcome to') ☐ next-action CTA ☐ AA contrast

column3: Feature icon — stroke-only, single hue
column4: width: 24px; height: 24px; stroke: var(--mn-fg-muted); fill: none; transition: stroke 200ms;
column5: ☐ stroke not fill ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ adequate contrast

column3: Focus ring — single hue, offset outline
column4: outline: 2px solid var(--mn-fg); outline-offset: 2px;
column5: ☐ visible on all interactive elements ☐ offset for readability ☐ AA contrast

column3: Hover affordance — opacity or weight shift, no chromatic shift
column4: transition: opacity 150ms ease-out; opacity: 0.85;
column5: ☐ no chromatic hover ☐ opacity 0.7-0.9 range ☐ reduced-motion freezes

column3: Vertical list — monotone, sibling-gap
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
column5: ☐ semantic <ul>/<li> ☐ AA contrast ☐ no chromatic markers

column3: Footer — monotone, generous padding
column4: padding-block: 64px; background: var(--mn-bg-elev); border-top: 1px solid var(--mn-border);
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ multi-column responsive ☐ no chromatic accent
